note: Georgia (Government ordinance under the Law on Legal Status of Aliens of 2014, as amended): nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for a year, 90 days, 45 (Iran) or 30 (China, Hong Kong, Macao); those on the e-Visa lists apply online (90 days in 180, or 30 in 120). Kosovo's, Palestine's and Taiwan's passports are refused (visas case by case: taken as a visa); everyone else needs a visa (holders of certain third-country visas or residences may enter for 90 in 180: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
